question: Who has been nominated as Ambassador for War Against Waste in Jammu and Kashmir, in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bana Singh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Captain Bana Singh was nominated as the ambassador for the "War Against Waste" initiative in Jammu and Kashmir in September 2023: 
 
• Captain Singh is a retired Indian soldier and recipient of the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military decoration.
 
• The "War Against Waste" initiative is a part of the Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen and aims to address waste management and environmental conservation issues in rural areas of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The initiative's goals include: Promoting sustainable practices, Raising awareness, Inspiring local communities to reduce waste, and Preserving the natural beauty of Jammu and Kashmir. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amit Shah
 
 
• A key leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), Amit Shah has played a pivotal role in the party's electoral strategies and expansion. He served as the BJP President from 2014 to 2020.
